svg.title: The same page has different roles for agents and maintainer
svg.desc: Repeat the identical page on both sides with different functional framing. Useful relay and unwanted material describe perspectives on the same object, not different contents.

**Action:** The same object is a channel to one party and litter to the other.

**Caption:**
> NEITHER SIDE IS WRONG ABOUT WHAT THE PAGE IS.
